messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for service: inference-runner (commit abc123). Rolling traffic to model rwd/open-13b-v2@2026-03-15 :rocket:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated error rate and generation quality regression detected for model rwd/open-13b-v2 in prod. Sev: P1. Paging oncall (alex).
alex: paging in. seeing spike in failed responses and hallucination score jumps in synthetic evals. routing failures to fallback model also increased.
sara: noticed customer reports about 'weird outputs' in #support. ETA for RCA?
alex: initial check: latency ok, GPU metrics normal. issue seems model-output-related (coherence drop). Suspect model release.
mike: i can roll back the model to previous pinned version quickly if needed. Which version should we pin to?
julie: previous stable was rwd/open-13b-v1@2026-02-28. That one passed production evals.
ops_lead: do rollback as mitigation, but keep canary on until we confirm. Also prepare status page copy.
alex: executing rollback now. command:
```bash
redwoodctl models set-variant --service inference-runner --model rwd/open-13b-v1@2026-02-28 --weight 100
```
alex: applied. routing shows 100% to v1 in ~12s. Monitoring quality traces.
sara: support, please hold off on broad customer emails until we confirm impact window. We should ack customers with a short note first.
support: will draft an initial ack for customers who pinged.
deploy-bot: Rollback action recorded by ops (user: alex). Change-id: roll-20260315-xyz.
mike: quality traces look back to normal within two gen cycles. hallucinations back to baseline.
julie: good. can we pin v1 to prevent accidental promote? propose policy: pin stable model in service config: 
```yaml
service: inference-runner
model_pinned: rwd/open-13b-v1@2026-02-28
pin_reason: emergency rollback - quality regression on v2
```
ops_lead: yes pin and add a hold so CI/CD cannot auto-promote v2 until manual review.
alex: done: pinned. Also set rollout-block to true in the model catalog.
incident-bot: NOTE: oncall handoff scheduled. alex handing to sara at +30m.
sara: i'm taking lead for postmortem and comms. next steps: 1) collect eval diffs between v1 and v2 on canonical prompt set, 2) identify model change that caused regression (tokenization or new fine-tune?), 3) update rollout policy and add automated quality gate.
mike: I'll run a targeted delta eval and surface top 20 prompts with largest divergence.
julie: drafting status page update (short):
"We experienced a short regression in text generation quality affecting a subset of requests between 17:06 and 17:11 UTC. Traffic was rolled back to a previously stable model and full service has been restored. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a detailed postmortem."
sara: looks good, add "no customer data was exposed" line if validated.
support: initial customer ack template: 
"Thanks for flagging this. We're aware of an issue affecting some generation results for a small subset of users; we've rolled back to a stable model and are monitoring. We'll update you once we finish our investigation. If you see a specific bad output, please share it here and we'll prioritize."
ops_lead: also notify enterprise customers via direct channel with bullet points and ETA for detailed postmortem (24-48h).
alex: adding internal comms template for engineers: 
- Incident summary (what happened)
- Mitigation actions (rollback, pin, monitoring)
- Impact scope (percent of requests, customers affected)
- Next steps (postmortem owner, timeline, follow-ups)
- Runbook changes (quality gate added to rollout)

sara: assigning postmortem to alex + mike, draft due EOD tomorrow. I will own customer-facing postmortem.
mike: collecting logs and model diffs now. will upload to /internal/incidents/1743500001 (shared drive).
support: sent initial acks to 3 customers who opened tickets. enterprise outreach scheduled at 17:45 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation successful, service stable. Closing active paging.
julie: quick retrospective note: we should add a pre-rollout smoke that runs half-hour batch eval on production prompts to catch this class of regression (automated fail if quality delta > threshold).
alex: agreed. filed ticket: PROD-1234 add pre-rollout batch-eval + block-promote.
sara: thanks team. will post formal status page update and customer message in ~1h once we have root cause details. :thumbsup:
support: closing thread from support side after monitoring window clear.
